seo.title: Modern Slavery Statement
seo.description: Edstellar's modern slavery statement sets out our zero-tolerance approach to modern slavery, forced labour and human trafficking across our operations and supply chains.

hero.heading: Modern slavery statement.
hero.description: Our commitment to upholding the highest ethical standards across our business operations and supply chains, with a zero-tolerance approach to modern slavery, forced labour and human trafficking.

image.alt: A diverse team working together around a laptop

blocks.text: At Edstellar Inc., we are committed to upholding the highest ethical standards in our business operations and supply chains. We have a zero-tolerance approach to modern slavery, forced labour and human trafficking in any form.
To ensure compliance with labour laws and human rights standards, we have implemented robust policies and procedures that:

items: Prohibit modern slavery and exploitative labour practices.
Conduct due diligence on our suppliers and partners to assess potential risks.
Provide training and awareness programmes to help employees recognise and report concerns.
Maintain confidential reporting mechanisms for stakeholders to report any suspicions or violations.
Take immediate corrective action when risks or incidents are identified.

blocks.text: We are dedicated to creating a workplace and business environment that promotes fairness, dignity and respect for all individuals.

blocks.heading: Report a concern
